meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把原始数据组织成有开头、冲突和结论的故事，生成含关键洞察、图表、建议和行动号召的报告或演示，并可套用问题-解决方案、趋势、比较等框架。
howto.when: 当你要求向高管等展示数据分析、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示、写数据报告，或向非技术受众说明数据时，就会触发。

say.text: 把这份销售数据讲成一个故事，先给结论再解释原因。
say.note: Claude 会按故事结构组织内容。

say.text: 用问题-解决方案框架分析客户流失，给出建议。
say.note: 会生成包含钩子、背景、解决方案等部分的报告。

say.text: 将 Q4 数据做成趋势故事，突出关键转折点。
say.note: 会生成趋势叙事并配可视化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will turn raw data into a narrative with setup, conflict, and resolution, producing reports or presentations with key insights, charts, recommendations, and call-to-action. It can apply frameworks like problem-solution, trend, and comparison.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask for analytics presentations to stakeholders, quarterly business reviews, investor presentations, data-driven reports, or communicating insights to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this sales data into a story, starting with the conclusion.
say_en.note: Claude organizes content in story structure.

say_en.text: Use the problem-solution framework to analyze churn and recommend.
say_en.note: Generates a report with hook, context, solution, etc.

say_en.text: Make a trend story from Q4 data, highlighting turning points.
say_en.note: Creates a trend narrative with visualization suggestions.
